Name: Jewish Chuppah - Wedding Arch Replacement
Description:
This sprite was made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] at the request of someone wanting a chuppah for the Jewish marriage candidates (Elliott and Alex). I've also included it here in this mod so you can always have it no matter who you marry :)

You can choose between a 'white' style and a 'wooden' style for the frame. I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for changing config options.

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] for more Jewish representation! You might also be interested in Elaho's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10900]Alex Jewish Wedding Suit[/url] mod.

[color=#b6b6b6][size=1]﻿[i]Yes, I understand the page title is rather redundant. Blame Nexus's search algorithm, not me 😅[/i][/size][/color]
